Let’s now look through the place I saw the blood. It was dark back then so maybe that murderer did not clean up all traces after himself.

There is some discoloration in that place so I did not just dream about it, but I don’t seem to be able to find anything meaningful.
Maybe there will be something in different places? I’m already here so I might as well just look through all of this place.
